en.name: Moonchild
en.ability: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player. Tonight, if it was a good player, they die.
en.flavor: Scorpio looks sideways at the lovers, and you have a choice to make. With silver cross my palm, and your fate shall be revealed. With steel cross my throat, and by the stars you shall regret it.
